decision_question: Can a causal invertible Butterfly-lifting representation with low-rank coarse memory, tile-sparse high-rank details, and K/V-selected cyclic motion predictors preserve LongLive attention output at at least 1.5x cache compression?
leakage_policy: Shift IDs and sparse detail tiles may use only the current record's K/V reconstruction energy; dense attention and dense AV are evaluation-only.
Adaptive rank-16 correction reads the same-record dense defect and is an explicitly non-deployable capacity diagnostic.
Validation and test records may not select candidates, detail fraction, K/V weights, exact frames, rank, or quality gates.
The existing captures are development-exposed and support an exploratory gate only; confirmation requires newly registered captures.
stop_rules: Stop learned detail predictors, lazy decode kernels, and rollout work if the primary adaptive rank-16 capacity misses either adaptive quality gate.
If adaptive capacity passes but direct reconstruction fails, continue only as a bounded content-generated residual probe.
If shared cyclic prediction improves less than 10 percent over identity at the same detail budget, remove the circulant predictor from the candidate.
Do not claim attention or end-to-end speedup from cache compression or dense replay.
